children.text:
The new ink arrived with the
afternoon order.

I moved it to the lower cabinet
beside the sample paper.

Thanks. Are we making the tall
handouts or the shorter folded
maps?

Folded maps this time. Keep the
margins wide so people can write
notes.

I cut an extra stack in case a few
sheets get damaged.

The back room lamp is on. The
window by the sink can stay
closed.
I’ll come in through the courtyard.
I’ll check it at the long table.
I’ll leave the pencil on top.
